narrative.title: The Warehouse Aisle Shortlist
narrative.scenario: A warehouse scanner reads package weights one aisle at a time, and logistics wants the kth-lightest weight without a full sort. A holding bin keeps the k lightest weights seen so far, expelling its heaviest resident whenever a lighter package shows up. When the scan finishes, the bin's heaviest resident is exactly the kth-lightest weight.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array arr of distinct values and an integer K.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the Kth smallest element of arr.

testCases.explanation: The values below 7 are 3 and 4, so 7 is the third-smallest.
